title: Lag-1 consecutive-draw overlap-state memory diagnostic

hypothesis.null: Under independent uniform 5-of-40 draws, consecutive-draw overlaps K_t=|D_{t-1}∩D_t| are iid Hypergeometric(N=40,K=5,n=5); the previous observed overlap K_{t-1} does not improve the forecast of K_t over the exact marginal null.
hypothesis.alternative: The previous observed overlap K_{t-1} carries one-step information about the next overlap K_t, and a fixed kernel transition estimator improves proper scoring rules against the exact hypergeometric null.
hypothesis.estimand: For each target draw index t, estimate P(K_t=k | K_{t-1}) for k=0..5 using only previously observed overlap transitions; compare multiclass Brier and log loss against the exact null PMF.

definitions.draw: D_i is the 5-element subset on zero-based archive row i.
definitions.target: At target draw index t, current state is K_{t-1}; target outcome is K_t.
definitions.training_pairs: Only pairs (K_j,K_{j+1}) with j=1..t-2 are eligible; therefore the latest transition outcome ends at draw index t-1, strictly before target draw t.

exact_null.rationale: Conditional on any fixed previous 5-subset, a new independent uniform 5-subset has the same hypergeometric overlap law. Under iid draws the overlap sequence is iid by symmetry.

model.tie_break: If validation Brier ties exactly, choose the smaller bandwidth.

data.target_index_convention: zero-based index into data/storico_daily.csv; first scored target is the 302nd draw.
data.split_rule: Chronological contiguous target rows: first 1400 Discovery, next 850 Validation, final 852 historical Blind OOS.

selection.criterion: Minimum mean multiclass Brier score on Validation.

endpoints.primary: Mean multiclass Brier score over six overlap categories; gain=exact-null Brier minus model Brier, positive favors model.
endpoints.secondary: Mean categorical log loss; gain=exact-null log loss minus model log loss, positive favors model.

inference.family: Four fixed bandwidths × two fixed endpoints = 8 tests on historical Blind OOS.
inference.primary_test: Paired block sign-flip on per-target loss gains, contiguous block length 20, 50000 replicates, fixed seed 0x5100A102, one-sided alternative mean gain > 0, add-one p-value.
inference.uncertainty: Circular moving-block bootstrap, block length 20, 10000 replicates, fixed seed 0x5100B102, percentile 95% CI for mean paired gain.
inference.multiplicity: Holm step-down across all 8 Q102 p-values. Also report Bonferroni ×43 as a conservative catalogue-level screen, explicitly not a correction for unknown analyst degrees of freedom or the entire lifetime search.

integrity_checks: Validate canonical archive header, strict date order, five sorted distinct integers 1..40 per draw, row count and cutoff.
Recompute every consecutive overlap from canonical draws.
For each forecast, assert all training transition outcomes end at or before the previous draw (max eligible pair endpoint index t-1).
All six-category forecast PMFs and exact-null PMF sum to one within 1e-12.
Future-mutation invariance at fixed cutoffs: changing target and later draws must not change the pre-target forecast.
Deterministic replay of forecasts, bootstrap and sign-flip with fixed seeds.
guardrails: This is a retrospective historical diagnostic; historical Blind OOS has been exposed to extensive prior SONAR research and is not a virgin prospective holdout.
The outcome is an overlap count, not a prediction of any specific number or quintet; even a detected dependence would not itself justify a new number-ranking engine.
No active engine, candidate ranking, prospective freeze, H101/H102 ledger or Q60 gate may be modified.
No missing freeze may be reconstructed; no automatic merge or promotion.
next_action: Stop retrospective overlap tuning if no robust gain is demonstrated; continue Q60 append-only prospective collection and wait for an official result before evaluating the 2026-11-10 frozen forecasts.
